query: SELECT DISTINCT cause_inference.sequence_id AS "cause_sequence_id!: i64"              FROM sequence_cause              JOIN tool_execution ON tool_execution.id = sequence_cause.source_tool_execution_id              JOIN inference AS cause_inference ON cause_inference.id = tool_execution.inference_id              WHERE sequence_cause.child_sequence_id = ? AND cause_inference.sequence_id IS NOT NULL              ORDER BY 1
